title_sq: Vile Elitare me pishine tek "Collina Verde"!
description_sq:
Vile Elitare me pishine ne shitje tek "Collina Verde"!
Pozicionuar fare prane qendres tregtare me te madhe ne vend, me akses direkt ne unazen e madhe te kryeqytetit, ne nje zone maksimalisht te zhvilluar, me cdo facilitet per nje jetese komode.
Vila ka nje siperfaqe totale ndertimi 465m2, dhe siperfaqe totale parcele 710m2, te organizuara ne 3 kate.
- sallon ndenje i bollshem,
- ambient gatimi dhe ngrenie i vecuar,
- 5 dhoma gjumi, (njera prej te cilave Master, me tualet dhe garderobe),
- 4 tualete,
- pishine + oborr qe rrethon vilen,
- "Gaming room', kinema, minibar, ambient ndenje i vecuar me akses ne oborrin e viles,
- dhome teknike, garderobe, lavanderi, etj.
- 2 poste parkimi te mbyllura, me qepen.
- Rezidenca eshte ne fazen finale te punimeve, nje projekt ambicioz, ku cilesia e punimeve eshte e padiskutueshme, me cdo faze qe do të kryhet në përputhje me standartet e panegociueshme europiane të cilësisë.
Vila mund te personalizohet, ne organizimin e ambienteve dhe rifinitura.
Per me shume informacion kontaktoni!
title_en: Elite villa with pool at "Collina Verde"!
description_en: Elite villa with pool for sale in "Collina Verde"! Positioned very close to the largest shopping center in the country, with direct access to the capital's ring road, in a maximally developed area, with every facility for a comfortable life. The villa has a total construction area of ​​465m2, and a total plot area of ​​710m2, organized on 3 floors. - spacious living room, - separate kitchen and dining area, - 5 bedrooms, (one of which is the master, with toilet and wardrobe), - 4 toilets, - swimming pool + courtyard surrounding the villa, - "Gaming room", cinema, minibar, separate living room with access to the courtyard of the villa, - technical room, wardrobe, laundry, etc. - 2 closed parking spaces, with shutters. - The residence is in the final phase of the works, an ambitious project, where the quality of the works is indisputable, with each phase being carried out in accordance with non-negotiable European quality standards. The villa can be customized, in the organization of the premises and refinished. For more information, contact
